You will be given the root cause of a bug, the commit message and the corresponding patch.
        You need to extract all code statements that lead to the bug from the patch, based on the root cause and the commit message.

        Root cause:
        The bug was caused by the `DownloadManagerInterface` being bound to the main activity instead of the application object, which necessitated unregistering the download receiver in the `onDestroy()` method of the activity. Failure to do so could lead to memory leaks or unintended behavior due to the receiver remaining active after the activity is destroyed.
        
        Commit message:
        Dispose of DownloadManagerInterface in onDestroy.

This fixes a bug introduced in cf27461bfaa78798252103345b1c14528bb4828c. Prior
to that commit, the DMI was bound to the Application object and there was no
reason to unregister the download receiver. Now that it's bound to the main
activity, there is.

+        super.onDestroy();
+        DownloadManagerInterface.getInstance().destroy(this);
